record.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:10 — update` performs no update (just re-serializes) and the client `saveChanges` action is never wired to the template, so the PUT route is a misleading no-op that always reports success.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders `@embedding` without modifying any state (`render_serialized(@embedding, ...)`), while `@embedding` is an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding` (so there’s nothing to persist). Routes add a PUT endpoint (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`), and the Ember controller defines `saveChanges() { this.get('embedding').update({}); }`, but `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs` never invokes `saveChanges` (only `addHost`/`deleteHost` are used). This makes the PUT route/action effectively a misleading no-op and dead/unwired code, but it doesn’t break the current UI because actual changes are done via `embeddable-host` saves/deletes.
